searchText: Hmm interesting. So 5) isn't actually merging two chains, it's just merging the two clients? I agree that having that separate gives options, I like the modularity of having four clients to choose from on either side. Does the "quick merge" (just swapping the consensus engine from PoW to PoS) result in any scalability/throughput gains for L1? to my understanding, it does not. <dankrad> you can get some gains, because the block timing would be deterministic rather than random thus reducing uncle risks. However exploiting this has some other disadvantages
